Summary

Adds docs/verification/2026-11-03-ui-checks/, a verification record of the ad hoc UI checks I ran while building #13, #15 and #16. For each check (V1–V11) it gives the method, the result and the change it led to. It also lists what wasn't checked, such as mouse clicks, visual layout and reopening from the Dock. The test scripts and their outputs are kept exactly as they ran.

These checks found two crashes and two focus bugs that unit tests couldn't reach. The record is the starting point for a repeatable UI test harness traced to requirements and risks, which is next.

Testing

No code changes; the record is documentation only.
